changeSet.author: claude (P4-19)
changeSet.comment: Rating aggregates on the listing row, kept in the same transaction as every rating write so browse needs no join or GROUP BY: rating_count and rating_sum (the average is sum/count, computed on read), and rating_score, the Bayesian average (rating_sum + C*m) / (rating_count + C) with prior mean m = 3 and weight C = 5 (DictionaryRatingServiceImpl), so one 5-star vote cannot top the chart. Its default 3 is the score of an unrated listing. Top-rated browse orders by rating_score among listed, rated rows; the partial index matches that query exactly (same shape as idx_dictionary_stats_listed_popular).

sql.sql: ALTER TABLE dictionary_stats ADD COLUMN rating_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN rating_sum INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN rating_score DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 3; CREATE INDEX idx_dictionary_stats_listed_top_rated ON dictionary_stats (rating_score DESC, published_at DESC, dictionary_id) WHERE is_listed AND rating_count > 0;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_dictionary_stats_listed_top_rated; ALTER TABLE dictionary_stats DROP COLUMN rating_count, DROP COLUMN rating_sum, DROP COLUMN rating_score;
